name: Doro Wot

name: Special Injera Beyaynetu
description: A vibrant platter of shiro, misir wot, gomen, atkilt, and kik alicha served atop sourdough injera.

name: Shiro Tegabino
description: Bubbling clay pot seasoned chickpea powder stew served hot with fresh injera.

name: Tibs Firfir

name: Gomen Besiga
description: Fresh collard greens cooked with spiced beef chunks, garlic, and ginger.

description: Finely minced lean beef seasoned with spiced clarified butter (niter kibbeh) and mitmita chili, served with fresh cottage cheese (ayib) and gomen.

name: Shekla Tibs
description: Sizzling prime beef cubes served in an authentic Ethiopian clay brazier with fresh rosemary and green peppers.
